description: Genie Ontology Modeled Knowledge SDK pipeline run for project {{project_name}}, domain {{domain_name}}: inputs check, parallel discovery (research, supplemental context, deep EDA), metric view synthesis, registration, UC Pages + Genie Agent curation, agent deployment, tuning. waves.name: Inputs Check
gate: All session status files have status pass

sdk_config.json passes genie_ontology_modeled_knowledge_sdk.config.validate_config with 0 errors (installed genie_ontology_modeled_knowledge_sdk {{sdk_version}}: python -m genie_ontology_modeled_knowledge_sdk.config, or gos-* CLIs)
docs/inputs_report.md exists, lists every expanded source table, and its '## Access problems' section says 'none'

sessions.title: Inputs Check & Report
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 01: load and validate sdk_config.json, expand source tables, run config.check_access, write docs/inputs_report.md. Read-only on Unity Catalog. No Git commands.

waves.name: Discovery (research, context, EDA in parallel)
gate: All session status files have status pass
docs/research/ has 01-04 research docs plus 05_domain_subdomain_proposal.md, each with at least one URL
docs/semantics/ has at least one glossary term file and genie_ontology_modeled_knowledge_sdk.pages.parse_glossary('docs/semantics') parses all of them without error
docs/context/00_source_inventory.md exists (it may state 'no supplemental inputs provided')
docs/data_profiles/ has one profile per table listed in docs/inputs_report.md plus data_model_summary.md, whose join table has a verified_cardinality for every row

sessions.title: Domain Research & Glossary
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 02 using the ontology-domain-research skill (load it by its Unity Catalog id from sdk_config.json skills; fallback: skills/ontology-domain-research/SKILL.md in the SDK checkout): docs/research/01-05 and glossary term files in docs/semantics/ for {{domain_name}}. Metadata-only table reads. No Git commands.

sessions.title: Supplemental Context Extraction
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 03 using the ontology-context-extraction skill (load it by its Unity Catalog id from sdk_config.json skills; fallback: skills/ontology-context-extraction/SKILL.md in the SDK checkout): read supplemental_volume_dirs and dashboard_inputs (read-only) and write docs/context/**, including the no-inputs path. No Git commands.

sessions.title: Deep EDA & Join Cardinality
sessions.scope: All tasks in plan 04 using the ontology-deep-eda skill (load it by its Unity Catalog id from sdk_config.json skills; fallback: skills/ontology-deep-eda/SKILL.md in the SDK checkout): one profile per source table and data_model_summary.md with verified join cardinalities. Read-only SQL. No Git commands.

gate: All session status files have status pass
